tracker: TIN-5614 (web_jobs follow-up for the share_export refusal)

root_cause.summary: The check was too strict for a valid input. The web job passed the run-dir export artifacts/runs/20261006T041633Z-990aa1bd6737/export/cleaned-video.mov (sha256 91b2f436...). That MOV has an edit list (video media_time 15200/19200 s). Its first 10 of 3,631 video packets are decode-only pre-roll: ffprobe flag D, PTS -14368..-800 in a 1/19200 time base, about -0.748 s to 0 s. A decoder consumes these packets but never presents them. The H.264 re-encode with -fps_mode passthrough therefore correctly writes 3,621 frames. verify_packets compared the raw total packet count (3,631 vs 3,621) and refused with 'video packet count changed'. No frame was dropped or duplicated.
root_cause.input_passed_by_web_job: run-dir export/cleaned-video.mov (role 'accepted FULLER audio run, export/cleaned-video'), not the accepted marked movie
root_cause.why_desktop_export_passed: The Desktop file was not an H.264 share_export of the marked movie. root/media_latency encoded accepted-marked-video.mov to a 720p H.264 parent with an ad-hoc controller (artifacts/experiments/desktop-mvp-h264-crf27-20261006T0513/encode-plan.json). share_export then ran in codec=copy on that parent (share-export-tool30-20261006T0518/recipe.log). The parent has 3,621 packets starting at PTS 0 and no pre-roll, so the total and presented counts were equal.
root_cause.check_correctness: Comparing total packets is wrong for re-encodes because edit-list decode-only packets are not pictures. The integrity intent (no dropped, duplicated or shifted presented picture; identical tail) is kept by comparing presented packets. For copy, all coded packets must still match, including decode-only state.

change.worker: packets() also probes the ffprobe packet flags. verify_packets splits presented from decode-only (D) packets. Re-encodes compare presented packets on both sides, and dropped, duplicated, shifted and tail-changed pictures are still refused. Copy still requires every coded packet to match, plus identical per-packet decode-only state, payload hashes and DTS. Absent flags count as presented (the prior strict behavior). Malformed flags and sources with no presented packets are refused. The count refusal stays code validation_failed but names the scope and the presented/decode-only counts on both sides, and says not to bypass the check. The proof adds comparison_scope, source/output total, presented and decode-only counts; source_start/end use presented packets.
